traits.d: The lizard can hold its breath for 15 minutes. (A lizard that has this trait also has a swimming speed of 30 feet.)
The lizard can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

tips: Слабый спасбросок: Интеллект (-4) — эффекты и заклинания на эту характеристику с высокой вероятностью пройдут.
